original.statement: The Rancher v1 provider has been removed in Traefik v3; configurations using it will prevent Traefik from starting.

corrected.statement: Traefik v3 removed the Rancher v1 provider. Environments whose static configuration still sets providers.rancher (file key) or --providers.rancher (CLI flag) are exposed, because Traefik will not start with that configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-96141bfb2be5] shows only two ways the removed Rancher v1 provider is configured: the static file key `providers.rancher` (YAML/TOML) and the CLI flag `--providers.rancher=true`. It says this configuration now stops Traefik from starting. The evidence never mentions the TRAEFIK_PROVIDERS_RANCHER environment variable, so that operand is inferred rather than supported. The corrected exposure keeps only the two configuration forms the evidence shows.
